title: Lion Nathan Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Inner Circle Rum Pty Limited and Inner Circle Rum (Sales) Pty Limited
targets:
Inner Circle Rum Pty Limited
Inner Circle Rum (Sales) Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Lion Nathan Australia Pty Limited has entered into an agreement to acquire 100% of the issued share capital of Inner Circle Rum Pty Ltd and Inner Circle Rum (Sales) Pty Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of this competition assessment the relevant markets were considered to be at least state-based markets for the production and wholesale supply of: (i) rum; and (ii) ready-to-drink rum products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets, as it would only lead to a small increase in Lion Nathan Australia Pty Limited's market share in both markets, and there are a number of large competitors which are likely to be able to constrain the merged firm.
